cta.title: Want to try Mobilcab on your own projects?
cta.body: Mobilcab is a furniture CAD that runs straight from your browser. Use the app free on Cut list; join the Founding Partner list for **the first 2 months free** on your chosen plan (enrollment closes when paid plans launch). Later subscribers pay the standard price.
